title: Proper perfect pushforward has compact isomorphism tests
statement: Let X and Y be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], let f:X→Y be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and stalkwise of finite Tor dimension, and let R:D_QCoh(X)→D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-category] be identified, after the full inclusions, with the derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Equip both categories with the universe-u coproducts of lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums. There are a universe-u set S and objects G_s of D_QCoh(X) such that every G_s and every R(G_s) is compact [def-pc-compact-object], and for every morphism g:A→B in D_QCoh(X), bijectivity of Hom(G_s,g) for all s implies that g is an isomorphism. No right adjoint is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A9R, perfect direct-image input and perfect-generation detection; Tags 0B6G, 09M1, 09IS

proof.text: Use functorial K-injective resolutions to choose the small-Hom derived models on the schemes and every open, and transport between arbitrary given localizations through their localization equivalences. These equivalences commute with the localization functors on complexes, hence with homology, derived restriction and derived direct image by their universal properties. They preserve coproducts and Hom groups, so compactness, quasi-coherence and isomorphism detection transport. No arbitrary object is selected for a definition.

In the small-Hom models choose the u-small perfect representatives from lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set. This includes representatives of all shifts since shifts of strictly perfect local representatives remain strictly perfect. Noetherian schemes are qcqs. Perfect-object compactness gives compactness of each representative. The stalkwise finite-Tor and proper hypotheses give perfection of its direct image; perfect compactness on Y and the specified eR give compactness of its R-image.

If Hom(G_s,g) is bijective for all s, it is bijective from every perfect object and shift. Complete g to an ambient distinguished triangle. Its cone is quasi-coherent by the cohomology long exact sequence. Exactness and the Hom bijections force every Hom from shifted perfect objects to the cone to vanish. The class of objects all of whose shifts are orthogonal to the cone is closed under shifts, cones, retracts, isomorphisms and arbitrary coproducts. Perfect generation makes it the whole quasi-coherent derived category. Apply it to the cone itself: its identity is zero, hence the cone is zero and g is an isomorphism. Transfer the family through the localization equivalence to finish.

theorem properPerfect_compactTests
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hTor : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) (i : ℕ), n < i →
        IsZero (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) i).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)))).obj N))
    (R : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (eR : R ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ≅
      (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := derivedQCohDirectSums Y
    ∃ (S : Type u) (G : S → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X),
      (∀ s, IsCompactObject (G s) ∧ IsCompactObject (R.obj (G s))) ∧
      ∀ (A B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (g : A ⟶ B),
        (∀ s, Function.Bijective (fun a : G s ⟶ A ↦ a ≫ g)) → IsIso g
